description: directory.ex:753,765: repo.get_range(start_key, end_key) — the generated repo parses this as (range, opts) and Internal.Repo.get_range/4 does Keyword.get on a binary -> FunctionClauseError. Same for repo.clear_range(start_key, end_key). Pass {start_key, end_key} tuples. Independent of (but masked together with) the node-key prefix bug. Found in bedrock-ej0 audit.
title: do_move_recursive calls repo.get_range/clear_range with two binaries; crashes real repo
